title: Codeberg Bans Cryptocurrency and LLM-Generated Code Projects - Slashdot

content_html:
Longtime Slashdot reader AmiMoJo shares a report from Hackaday: Community-led open source project hosting site Codeberg has formally announced that projects whose code is largely or fully machine-generated through LLMs and other 'AI' tools will no longer be welcome. This follows on the heels of a similar ban on cryptocurrency-related projects. The community vote was on two issues, the first being the notion that scraping of project code for the use in LLMs should be forbidden, which was a motion that easily passed. The second motion was on disallowing projects whose code was substantially generated by LLMs like Claude, OpenAI Codex, and similar. This motion passed with 358 in favor versus 144 against.

In the earlier linked blog post the reasoning behind especially this second issue is expanded upon, covering not only "license whitewashing," but also the direct and indirect hardware costs, with the expanding 'AI' datacenter hyperscaling having massively increased hardware costs for Codeberg over the past years, as the costs have been largely externalized. Also covered is the aspect of these LLM-based tools destroying the OSS community, which is something that is backed up by recent studies.

sentences.zh: Slashdot 的长期读者 AmiMoJo 分享了 Hackaday 的一份报告：社区主导的开源项目托管网站 Codeberg 正式宣布，代码大部分或完全通过法学硕士和其他“人工智能”工具由机器生成的项目将不再受到欢迎。

sentences.en: The second motion was on disallowing projects whose code was substantially generated by LLMs like Claude, OpenAI Codex, and similar.
sentences.zh: 第二项动议是禁止其代码主要由 Claude、OpenAI Codex 等 LLM 生成的项目。

sentences.en: This motion passed with 358 in favor versus 144 against.
sentences.zh: 这项动议以 358 票赞成、144 票反对获得通过。

sentences.en: In the earlier linked blog post the reasoning behind especially this second issue is expanded upon, covering not only "license whitewashing," but also the direct and indirect hardware costs, with the expanding 'AI' datacenter hyperscaling having massively increased hardware costs for Codeberg over the past years, as the costs have been largely externalized.
sentences.zh: 在之前链接的博客文章中，特别是第二个问题背后的推理得到了扩展，不仅涵盖了“许可证洗白”，还涵盖了直接和间接的硬件成本，随着“AI”数据中心超大规模扩展的扩大，过去几年 Codeberg 的硬件成本大幅增加，因为成本已很大程度上外部化。

sentences.en: Also covered is the aspect of these LLM-based tools destroying the OSS community, which is something that is backed up by recent studies.
sentences.zh: 还涵盖了这些基于 LLM 的工具破坏 OSS 社区的方面，这是最近的研究所支持的。

content_html_zh: Slashdot 的长期读者 AmiMoJo 分享了 Hackaday 的一份报告：社区主导的开源项目托管网站 Codeberg 正式宣布，代码大部分或完全通过法学硕士和其他“人工智能”工具由机器生成的项目将不再受到欢迎。 在此之前，对加密货币相关项目也实施了类似的禁令。 社区投票涉及两个问题，第一个是应该禁止抓取项目代码用于法学硕士的想法，这是一项很容易通过的动议。 第二项动议是禁止其代码主要由 Claude、OpenAI Codex 等 LLM 生成的项目。 这项动议以 358 票赞成、144 票反对获得通过。 在之前链接的博客文章中，特别是第二个问题背后的推理得到了扩展，不仅涵盖了“许可证洗白”，还涵盖了直接和间接的硬件成本，随着“AI”数据中心超大规模扩展的扩大，过去几年 Codeberg 的硬件成本大幅增加，因为成本已很大程度上外部化。 还涵盖了这些基于 LLM 的工具破坏 OSS 社区的方面，这是最近的研究所支持的。
